events.label: Sputnik 1, first artificial satellite
events.description: The Soviet Union launches Sputnik 1 into Earth orbit.

events.label: Yuri Gagarin, first human in space
events.description: Vostok 1 carries Yuri Gagarin once around Earth.

events.label: Apollo 11 Moon landing
events.description: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin land on the Moon.

events.label: Viking 1 lands on Mars
events.description: First successful US landing on Mars, returning surface images.

events.label: Voyager 1 launch
events.description: Launched to fly past Jupiter and Saturn, then leave the Solar System.

events.label: First Space Shuttle flight
events.description: Columbia flies STS-1, the first reusable crewed spacecraft mission.

events.label: Hubble Space Telescope launch
events.description: Shuttle Discovery carries Hubble into orbit.

events.label: First ISS module (Zarya) launched
events.description: Assembly of the International Space Station begins.

events.label: Curiosity rover lands on Mars
events.description: The car-sized rover lands in Gale Crater (UTC date).

events.label: Voyager 1 reaches interstellar space
events.description: Voyager 1 crosses the heliopause, leaving the Sun's bubble of solar wind.

events.label: James Webb Space Telescope launch
events.description: Webb launches on an Ariane 5 from French Guiana.

events.label: Artemis I launch
events.description: Uncrewed Orion capsule flies around the Moon and back.
